verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requires closer adherence to the supplied script.
First concrete failure: client feedback states that the submitted video did not follow the script closely enough.
Post-redelivery persistence: the client reports the same adherence failure in the newly submitted video.
The client strengthens the requirement to strict coverage of every phrase.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Hi, first of all I stuck to the phrases strictly not only this time, also the previous video and they were both exaclty like you asked and even better than the sample video you sent.

Secondly, how are you so sure of the phrases if you don't have a translated script and made me translate it ?

I am not reshooting they are both great, if you don't like them let me know and at least pay half the amount. I am reporting this to Upwork.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer explicitly claims that both submitted videos followed the required phrases strictly.
